an10.237:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge of lust, ten things are to be developed.
an10.237:1.3: The perception of unattractiveness, the perception of death, the perception of the repulsiveness of food, the perception of non-delight in the entire world, the perception of impermanence, the perception of suffering in the impermanent, the perception of non-self in what is suffering, the perception of abandoning, the perception of dispassion, and the perception of cessation.
an10.237:1.4: For direct knowledge of lust, these ten things are to be developed.”
